claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament begins its first round on Thursday, April 9.
The honorary starters for the 2026 Masters Tournament are Gary Player, Jack Nicklaus, Tom Watson.
The honorary starters tee off at 7:25 a.m. ET for the first round of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
The first tee times for the first round of the 2026 Masters Tournament are at 7:40 a.m. ET.
The second round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Friday, April 10.
The first tee times for the second round of the 2026 Masters Tournament start at 7:40 a.m. ET.
The tee times for Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Saturday, April 11 begin around 10:30 a.m. ET.
The final round tee times for Round 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Sunday, April 12 start around 10:30 a.m. ET.
TV coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Thursday and Friday is 3-7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
TV coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Saturday and Sunday is 2-7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Featured groups streaming for the 2026 Masters Tournament begin earlier via Masters.com and Paramount+.
